lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured 2D grid of high-intensity circular spots arranged in approximately five discernible vertical columns and four horizontal rows posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Prominent vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with fainter horizontal lines, with high-luminance blobs centered at these grid-like anchor points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light-toned upper edges and shadowed lower edges.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of smaller, irregularly spaced high-luminance spots that deviate from the geometric grid pattern of the lateral flank.
